answers.how: The cup diameter is approximately 59 px and the toaster length is 195 px: 195 × 0.087 / 59.
The outlet height is approximately 34 px: 34 × 0.087 / 59.
Around 1 s, the cup moves approximately 61 px in 0.167 s. Converting with 0.087 m per 59 px gives 0.54 m/s.
The final visible motion is approximately constant at 300 px/s. Extrapolating to 2.25 s gives 300 × 0.087 / 59.
